notes.title: 🛠️ UI Update & Console Prep!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/edf930c3475880f706843111d2872519a6b8ae97.png[/img]
We've redesigned the interface and expanded the map to improve usability and prepare for the console build.
 
This is a key step ahead of version 0.0.3, where console implementation begins.
For now, we're focused on version 0.0.2 — and we're sharing updates as we go!

Thank you for following the development of The Chronicles of Overlord.
Your support means everything!

notes.title: Another update – we’ve added an Action Points (AP) Restoration Potion! 🔥
notes.content:
In the video, Succubus Lyria moves toward an enemy, losing AP, then drinks a restoration flask and gains +1 AP. 

[previewyoutube=GNp8vuISs1o;full][/previewyoutube]
This gives her the advantage to cast Hypnosis on the guard! 🌀
The potion comes in three levels—the higher the level, the more AP it restores.
You can buy it for gold from 🧙‍♂️ Alchemist Vemund. Plan ahead before battle! ⚔️

notes.title: 🔥Update time: We’ve made some tweaks to the interface for the next release!
notes.content:
🔥Update time: We’ve made some tweaks to the interface for the next release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/1fc71c8d6476e2e7c5a00173f6a13d45b71be373.jpg[/img]
👉Removed the hero icons on the left—they weren’t being used much and just took up space.
👉Moved the objectives panel to the left side.
👉Added a border around the screen inspired by classic fantasy games.
👉Introduced action point counters on the battlefield. Based on playtest feedback, we realized players needed a clearer way to calculate AP (action points). Now, when you hover over a tile within your movement range, a gray circle shows the AP cost to reach it.
👉Added AP tooltips to spells and basic attacks in the selection panel. This makes tactical planning easier. 
👉Added a border around the screen inspired by classic fantasy games. If you don’t have enough AP for a spell or attack, the gray circle won’t appear.

notes.title: Immersion in The Chronicles of Overlord
notes.content:
Dive into our world by mastering the game's fundamental mechanics! Here’s what you need to know:

[previewyoutube=p4KazcRFzkI;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*]Grid Movement: Explore the battlefield by moving across tiles to find optimal positions for attack or cover.
[*]Basic Attacks: Each character has a “regular attack,” such as a sword strike or a bow shot.
[*]Spells and Unique Attacks: Unlock powerful spells and special attacks to turn the tide of battle in your favor.
[*]Action Points: Plan your moves carefully! Action points determine how many actions you can take in a single turn, whether it’s moving, attacking, or casting spells.
[/list]
These elements form the foundation of The Chronicles of Overlord and all turn-based tactical games. Get ready for strategic decisions and thrilling combat!

notes.title: The Beginning of a Grand Game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43006540/598912e92bee993ca8b4e323d51b7e63bb67464b.png[/img]

Immerse yourself in a medieval world of swords and sorcery, inhabited by various races: humans, elves, orcs, undead, and many more. In this realm, four powerful artifacts—The Spheres of Omnipresence—shape the destiny of every being.

Each race wields a sphere that grants them incredible powers:

[list]
[*]Humans possess the Sphere of Creation, advancing magic and science to ensure the prosperity of their society.
[*]Elves guard the Sphere of Life, crafting miraculous potions and elixirs that grant healing and strength.
[*]Orcs command the Sphere of Destruction, harnessing fire and empowering their warriors with unmatched might.
[*]Necropolis controls the Sphere of Death, summoning souls and transforming them into undead to maintain the balance between life and death.
[/list]

But dark forces stir in the shadows: The Renegades, traitors to their people, seek to claim all the spheres and unleash the destructive power of the Devourer upon the world.

[b]Will you be able to stop this threat and protect your world? The grand game is just beginning.[/b]
